written.headline: Developers propose vertical data centers as Kansas City blocks high-rise plan
written.summary: Developers are proposing vertical data centers to address high demand and land limits in places like Taiwan. However, Kansas City recently rejected a 20-story tower proposal.

written.headline: Delhi High Court to examine if AI can be author under copyright law
written.summary: The Delhi High Court issued notice on an appeal by American computer scientist Stephen L Thaler challenging the Copyright Office's refusal to recognise his AI system DABUS as the author of an artwork. The Copyright Office previously ruled that while the artwork met originality requirements, an AI system cannot be an author under Section 2(d)(vi) of the Copyright Act, 1957.

written.headline: Dunzo cofounder Kabeer Biswas' AI startup M raises $9 Mn
written.summary: Dunzo cofounder Kabeer Biswas' AI startup M has raised $9 million in a funding round led by RTP Global. This brings the startup's total capital raised to about $20 million following a previous $11 million seed round.

written.headline: Swiggy Instamart lays off 340 employees amid AI push and inventory shift
written.summary: Swiggy's quick-commerce division, Instamart, is laying off 340 employees while restructuring its business amid increased AI adoption and a shift to an inventory model. The cutbacks come as the company faces competition from rivals including Zomato's Blinkit and Zepto.
